claims.statement: External software catalogs or developer portals may automatically write repository custom-property metadata, making the external system authoritative for those properties; examples include ownership, service tier and compliance status. These external properties may be used where GitHub-managed custom properties are used. Declared authority does not prove metadata truth, synchronization freshness, legal compliance, permission correctness, or a configured integration; no external writes were performed.

External custom properties are explicitly public preview and subject to change, using the pinned release-phase variable. This is not general availability, compatibility assurance, entitlement or accepted production policy.

Following organizations is labeled public preview and subject to change; the beta filename does not replace that textual release phase. This feature status does not grant visibility into inaccessible activity or verify an actual follow operation.

The Developer settings sidebar leads to GitHub Apps, with the pinned product variable resolving that name. This is navigation, not an app census, installed app, token scope, delegated manager privilege or authorization to register an app.

The organization Insights tab is identified by navigation text and a screenshot caption. Caption inspection is not image inspection, measured activity, complete insights coverage, access permission proof or an audit receipt.

Manage access provides Add people and Add teams entries. Opening that flow is distinct from accepted membership, an assigned repository role, effective inherited access, or authority to grant permissions.
